description:
You are assisting a researcher in evaluating disk performance while organizing datasets. The researcher needs you to benchmark and log the read performance on three different dataset directories: /home/user/dataset1, /home/user/dataset2, and /home/user/dataset3. 

Your task is as follows:
1. Measure how long it takes to list all files recursively in each of the directories (/home/user/dataset1, /home/user/dataset2, /home/user/dataset3) using a timing tool, capturing only the "real" time in seconds (the wall-clock execution time).
2. Create a log file named /home/user/disk_benchmark.log. For each dataset, record the dataset directory name and the measured "real" time, one per line.
3. The log file should have the following format (each value separated by a " - "):
   - Directory path (e.g., /home/user/dataset1)
   - The "real" time in seconds as a floating-point value with exactly 3 decimal places (e.g., 0.123)
   
Example log output:
```
/home/user/dataset1 - 0.115
/home/user/dataset2 - 0.251
/home/user/dataset3 - 0.098
```

Make sure your log file strictly matches this format so automated verification is possible.
truth:
Before the task begins, the following directories exist:
- /home/user/dataset1
- /home/user/dataset2
- /home/user/dataset3

Each directory contains at least one file (the content doesn’t affect the task but must exist for a realistic result). No disk_benchmark.log file exists at the start.

After correct execution, the file /home/user/disk_benchmark.log exists and contains three lines, each matching this pattern:

/home/user/dataset1 - {float with 3 decimals}
/home/user/dataset2 - {float with 3 decimals}
/home/user/dataset3 - {float with 3 decimals}

Values are the actual wall-clock time to list all files (using "real" time output) and rounded/truncated to exactly three decimal places. Lines are in order: first /home/user/dataset1, then /home/user/dataset2, then /home/user/dataset3.

Example valid content (actual timing values may differ based on the system):
/home/user/dataset1 - 0.019
/home/user/dataset2 - 0.012
/home/user/dataset3 - 0.011
